ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Persistence Via Powershell Search Order Hijacking - Task
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious powershell execution via a schedule task where the command ends with an suspicious flags to hide the powershell instance instead of executeing scripts or commands. This could be a sign of persistence via PowerShell "Get-Variable" technique as seen being used in Colibri Loader

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = "C\:\\WINDOWS\\System32\\svchost\.exe" AND (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-k\\ netsvcs.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-s\\ Schedule.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX("\\ \\-windowstyle\\ hidden$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\ \\-w\\ hidden$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\ \\-ep\\ bypass$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\ \\-noni$")))
